cells.name: uniform
cells.species: independent uniform random: clumps and gaps, the reference to beat

cells.name: stratified
cells.species: stratified / jittered: one random point per grid cell

cells.name: nrooks
cells.species: N-rooks (Latin hypercube): one point per row and per column

cells.name: multijitter
cells.species: correlated multi-jittered (Kensler): stratified in 2D and in each 1D projection

cells.name: poisson_disc
cells.species: Poisson disc by grid dominance: no two points closer than r

cells.name: jittered_hex
cells.species: a hex lattice with per-point jitter

cells.name: gaussian_cloud
cells.species: a Gaussian cloud from Box–Muller on random input

cells.name: halton
cells.species: Halton (2, 3): radical inverses in two bases

cells.name: cp_rotation
cells.species: Halton with a Cranley–Patterson rotation: shifted, still low-discrepancy

cells.name: hammersley
cells.species: Hammersley: i/n against the base-2 radical inverse

cells.name: sobol
cells.species: Sobol, first two dimensions — every power-of-two prefix is stratified

cells.name: r2
cells.species: Roberts' R2: fract(i · (φ₂⁻¹, φ₂⁻²)) with the plastic constant

cells.name: golden_spiral
cells.species: Vogel's sunflower: √i radius, golden-angle steps
eq: pᵢ = ½ + ½√((i + ½)/n)·(cos θᵢ, sin θᵢ)
n = round(32 + 480·count²)·scale,  m = n·(0.7 + 0.3 cos 0.45t) drawn

cells.name: fibonacci_lattice
cells.species: the Fibonacci lattice: i/n against fract(i/φ)
eq: n = round(32 + 480·count²)·scale,  m = n·(0.7 + 0.3 cos 0.45t) drawn

cells.name: rank1_lattice
cells.species: a rank-1 (Korobov) lattice fract(i/n · (1, a))

cells.name: bayer
cells.species: Bayer order: points appear as an ordered-dither matrix turns them on

cells.name: grid
cells.species: the regular grid: cell centres

cells.name: hex
cells.species: the hexagonal lattice, the densest packing

cells.name: brick
cells.species: brick: rows shifted by a fraction of a cell

cells.name: quincunx
cells.species: quincunx: a grid plus its cell centres

cells.name: rotated_grid
cells.species: rotated grid (RGSS): a grid turned so projections don't align

cells.name: spiral
cells.species: an Archimedean spiral at constant arc parameter
eq: n = round(32 + 480·count²)·scale,  m = n·(0.7 + 0.3 cos 0.45t) drawn

cells.name: disc_polar
cells.species: square → disc with r = u: points crowd the centre

cells.name: disc_sqrt
cells.species: square → disc with r = √u: uniform by area
eq: (u, v) = stratified jitter in the unit square
pᵢ = ½ + ½√u·(cos 2πv, sin 2πv)  (uniform by area)
n = round(32 + 480·count²)·scale,  m = n·(0.7 + 0.3 cos 0.45t) drawn

cells.name: disc_concentric
cells.species: Shirley–Chiu concentric map: strata survive as strata
eq: else:  r = b,  θ = π/2 − (π/4)(a/b);  p = ½ + ½r(cos θ, sin θ)
n = round(32 + 480·count²)·scale,  m = n·(0.7 + 0.3 cos 0.45t) drawn

cells.name: annulus
cells.species: square → annulus, area-uniform between two radii

cells.name: gaussian_bm
cells.species: Box–Muller on stratified input: the strata become rings

cells.name: tent
cells.species: grid jitter drawn from a tent filter — importance-sampled reconstruction

cells.name: sphere_fib
cells.species: spherical Fibonacci seen from above: density piles up at the limb
eq: pᵢ = ½ + 0.49·√(1 − zᵢ²)·(cos θᵢ, sin θᵢ)  (seen from above)
n = round(32 + 480·count²)·scale,  m = n·(0.7 + 0.3 cos 0.45t) drawn

cells.name: triangle
cells.species: uniform in a triangle via the √ barycentric warp
